output.summary: Adds a readable sketch of the shipped default process and makes the two-stage CLI disclosure explicit: next returns a frontier overview/start commands, then start returns an agent task card or executes an operation. Updates the existing ZzzOps diagram/prose while preserving parallel prerequisites, conceptual content, Prior Work, Future Work and the verified release pin. Scope remains docs-only and dev-only with existing checks and root-owned merge authority.

spec:
Owner request, verbatim: "Ok I think we should provide information about the default workflow. I don’t think it mentions anywhere how it’s the CLI that returns next instructions and it’s that that’s performing the disclosure."

Make a small focused documentation edit ONLY to docs/WHITEPAPER.md on current dev. Add an accessible sketch of the opinionated shipped default process: goal, design, independent review and adversarial critique, filtering, human design approval, test design and review, implementation, checks and implementation review/filter, integration PR, human merge approval, merge. Brief branch/base preparation may be parenthetic. Some phases can run in parallel; do not imply one rigid serial sequence or provide an exhaustive node catalogue. The actual fifteen-node graph comprises discovery design/review_design/adversary_design/filter_design/approve_design and delivery base/test_design/review_tests/implement/run_tests/review_impl/filter_impl/integrate/approve_merge/merge. Repository workflow, policy and prompts are customizable; stable mostly-unopinionated engine invariants are not all configurable.

Make the two-stage CLI disclosure concrete. `zzzops next` computes and returns a frontier view with multiple eligible actions (capacity/display rules may limit the visible set), waits, human items and exact start commands. The coordinator follows an eligible action's `zzzops start`: for an agent node it returns the task card with selected prompt, instructions, declared inputs/context and exact submit/renew commands; for an operation node start executes the operation rather than returning an agent card. Human decisions remain explicit CLI items. Agent results recorded with `zzzops submit` change state; the coordinator calls next again. The software/CLI selects disclosures; the coordinator follows them, rather than inventing a workflow or relying on a separate invisible scheduler. Do not say next itself returns full task instructions, or all nodes receive agent cards. Adjust existing diagram labels and equivalent prose to make these roles clear. A compact illustrative three-command loop is optional, not a full CLI reference.

Preserve the general immediate DPD definition, Prior Work and exact existing-term acknowledgement, Future Work, central customizable opinionated process versus mostly-unopinionated engine philosophy, and the verified Implementation note pin to actual v3.0.0 / ed91d6c64b45e9c5d97ff883fae395b540a8733e / package3.0.0 e4cf74f4b756. No blog, evidence appendix, broad research, runtime, policy, templates, framework, test or checker changes. Targeted inspection of current next/start/card/op semantics and shipped current workflow is enough. Source base actual dev ffb3e43f3be01ebd7733a3751d57f79c5dc7f33b. Use a short concrete design (about300–500words), concise independent phase reviews, an unchanged-test checkpoint and existing whitespace command; no new tests for prose. Required configured local full validation must pass before remote CI, once on the actual changed tree.

This is a tracked release2/P1 docs follow-up with no open dependencies. Do not touch the old primary checkout or its untracked AGENTS.md; use the engine-managed goal worktree. Routine approvals may use the standing exact quote "Do not wait for my approval", decided_by "Codex (root agent), delegated by Dave". Root owns final fresh full CI/exact-head verification and all admin merge mutations; the coordinator prepares the normal dev PR and reconciles only after root supplies the actual dev merge receipt. The explicit owner override "Don’t merge the paper to main" persists: ABSOLUTELY NO main promotion, main branch/worktree/push/PR/write, release/tag changes, publication or banked reset. Stop after dev goal reconciliation and managed-worktree cleanup.
title: explain the whitepaper default workflow and CLI disclosure loop
